title.narrative: Eastern and Southern Africa Higher Education Centers of Excellence

description.narrative: The development objective of Eastern and Southern Africa Higher Education Centers of Excellence Project in Africa is to strengthen selected Eastern and Southern African higher education institutions to deliver quality postgraduate education and build collaborative research capacity in the regional priority areas. This project has three components. 1) The first component, Strengthening Africa Centers of Excellence (ACEs) in Regional Priority Areas, the International Development Association (IDA) Credit will finance the strengthening of twenty four ACEs in five clusters of regional priorities – Industry, Agriculture, Health, Education and Applied Statistics. 2) The second component, Capacity Building Support to ACEs through Regional Interventions, the IDA Credit will finance activities at the regional level to enhance the capacity of the ACEs and help them overcome key challenges for achieving the Project Development Objective (PDO). 3) The third component, Facilitation, Coordination and Administration of Project Implementation,financed in the form of Regional IDA Grant will explore networks of regional institutions and industries within and outside of the Eastern and Southern Africa (ESA) region and manage Technical Assistance (TA) firm(s), as needed, to ensure effective project preparation and implementation and oversee, administer, and coordinate Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) activities across the ACEs to ensure their achievement of the agreed Disbursement Linked Indicator (DLI) results.
To strengthen selected Eastern and Southern African higher education institutions to deliver quality post-graduate education and build collaborative research capacity in the regional priority areas.

condition.narrative: Finance Agreement :Adoption of Project Operational Manual (POM) | Description :The Recipient IUCEA shall: (a) adopt not later thanone month after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain the Project Operational Manual in form and substance satisfactory totheAssociation; and (b) carry out the Project in accordance with said POM, in accordance with the provisions of Schedule 2, SectionI, E, 1 of the IUCEA Financing Agreement. | Due Date :30-Jun-2016

Finance Agreement :Hiring of Independent Verifier(s) | Description :The Recipient IUCEA shall be responsible to carry out theverification of the proper fulfillment of DLIs and DLRs through the Independent Verifiers (for DLI 2 - DLI 4 and DLR 2.1 - DLR4.2), to be hired in accordance with the provisions of Schedule 2, Section I, C, 1 of the IUCEA Financing Agreement, not later thansix months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintained under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association. | Due Date:31-Dec-2016

Finance Agreement :Implement the Project in accordance with the Project Implementation Plan (PIP) | Description :The Recipientshall cause the Africa Centers of Excellences to: (i) adopt not later than one month after the Effective Date and, thereaftermaintain their respective PIPs in form and substance satisfactory to the Association; and (ii) carry out the Project in accordancewith the PIP and Environmental and Social Management Plan. This covenant is based on Schedule 2, Section I, F, (a) of the FinancingAgreement, and is applicable to all the participating countries. | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Maintain Project Implementation Teams in ESA Higher Education Institutions | Description :The Recipient shallmaintain throughout the period of Project implementation, the Project Implementation Teams in the Eastern and Southern AfricaHigher Education Institutions to run day-to-day management of the Project. This covenant is based on Schedule 2, Section I, A, 3 ofthe Financing Agreement, and is applicable to all the participating countries. | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Maintain the National Representative in the Regional Steering Committee (RSC) | Description :The Recipient shallmaintain throughout the period of Project implementation its representative in the RSC to provide overall guidance and oversightfor the Project at the regional level, and to participate in semi-annual meetings. This covenant is based on Schedule 2, Section I,A, 1 of the Financing Agreement, and is applicable to all the participating countries. | Frequency :SemiAnnual

Finance Agreement :Maintain the National Steering Committee (NSC) | Description :The Recipient shall maintain throughout the periodof Project implementation the NSC to hold semi-annual reviews of performance and implementation support for the Project at thenational level, including approvals of Annual Work Programs and implementation planning. This covenant is based on Schedule 2,Section I, A, 2 of the Financing Agreement, and is applicable to all the participating countries. | Frequency :SemiAnnual
